description.p: Mappa is a Linux-first workstation for offline maps: download a region, pack it into MBTiles or PMTiles, open DEM for terrain and radio links, record GPS/NMEA tracks, georeference scanned maps and export missions to QGroundControl. Packs can be served to a team over the local network.

ul.li: Offline packs with signatures, CLI and LAN tile server
DEM, contours, line-of-sight and first Fresnel zone
GPS, NMEA, gpsd and MAVLink telemetry

description.p: MAVLink telemetry, georeferencing with TPS and polynomial transforms, radio link and viewshed, mission export.
